item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Vivaan shining a torch at three sheets M, N and O. Through M almost all the light passes and shapes look clear. Through N only some light passes and shapes look unclear. Through O no light passes.

Which claim is correct?

options.A: N is translucent because only some light passes and shapes look unclear.
options.B: N is transparent because some light passes through it.
options.C: N is opaque because shapes look unclear.
options.D: M is translucent because almost all the light passes through it.
